exercises.q: What does у- add in удво́ить (“to double, to redouble”)?
options: keeping in the state the base verb names
destroying or using up the object by the action of the base verb
moving away from, leaving a place by the action of the base verb
making the object as many times bigger as the base numeral says
exercises.why: The Russian Wiktionary lists удво́ить under this meaning of у-. Source: Russian Wiktionary, «у-», meaning 9 (https://ru.wiktionary.org/wiki/у-).

exercises.q: What does в- add in вдво́е (“twice”)?
options: movement into something
quantity
thoroughness, fullness of an action
the manner of an action, given by the base word
exercises.why: The Russian Wiktionary lists вдво́е under this meaning of в-. Source: Russian Wiktionary, «в-», meaning 6 (https://ru.wiktionary.org/wiki/в-).

exercises.q: What does в- add in втро́е (“three times as much”)?
options: thoroughness, fullness of an action
quantity
giving or acquiring a status or state
the manner of an action, given by the base word
exercises.why: The Russian Wiktionary lists втро́е under this meaning of в-. Source: Russian Wiktionary, «в-», meaning 6 (https://ru.wiktionary.org/wiki/в-).

exercises.q: What does в- add in вдвоём (“two (together), both (together)”)?
options: thoroughness, fullness of an action
movement into something
the manner of an action, given by the base word
quantity
exercises.why: The Russian Wiktionary lists вдвоём under this meaning of в-. Source: Russian Wiktionary, «в-», meaning 6 (https://ru.wiktionary.org/wiki/в-).

exercises.q: What does в- add in втроём (“three (together)”)?
options: thoroughness, fullness of an action
giving or acquiring a status or state
quantity
the manner of an action, given by the base word
exercises.why: The Russian Wiktionary lists втроём under this meaning of в-. Source: Russian Wiktionary, «в-», meaning 6 (https://ru.wiktionary.org/wiki/в-).

exercises.q: Match each word with its meaning (Wiktionary's definitions).
exercises.why: From Wiktionary: удво́ить — to double, to redouble; вдво́е — twice; втро́е — three times as much; вдвоём — two (together), both (together).
